key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual over months. LOCATION: Focal or diffuse lung areas. DURATION: Chronic, progressive. CHARACTER: Chronic cough, chest pain, dyspnea. AGGRAVATING: Exertion, lying flat. RELIEVING: Pain medications, oxygen. TIMING: Chronic, progressive. SEVERITY: Moderate to severe (5-8/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Chronic cough, hemoptysis, chest pain, dyspnea, weight loss, fatigue, hoarseness, bone pain. KEY POSITIVES: Smoking history, chronic cough, hemoptysis, weight loss. KEY NEGATIVES: No fever (unless infection), no wheezing (unless obstruction).

red_flags: Signs of superior vena cava syndrome
